This use-after-free can cause crashes, memory corruption and may lead to further exploitation such as arbitrary code execution.

if start == -1 or end_else == -1:
    print('Pattern not found')
else:
    replacement = (
        '\n\tif (Z_TYPE_P(array) == IS_ARRAY) {\n'
        '\t\tZVAL_ARR(&intern->array, zend_array_dup(Z_ARR_P(array)));\n'
        '\t} else {\n'
    )
    new_text = text[:start] + replacement + text[end_else+len('} else {'):]
    p.write_text(new_text)
    print('Patched spl_array.c to simplify array assignment')
